verdict.rationale: Wave offers basic bank feed auto-import/categorization but there is no evidence of any agentic capability to autonomously reconcile a full month end-to-end, flag exceptions, or prepare a close for human review. No API, MCP, or agent-facing surface is documented (developer portal is crawl-walled, no llms.txt/openapi), so an ai-native agent could not even access Wave programmatically to perform this workflow.
